**Headline correction: there are 14 KRs, not 9.** The OKR doc is **v3, restructured 2026-07-17** (4 objectives, 14 KRs). The 9-KR table in the cadence doc is the **superseded v2 set** — the cadence doc is dated 2026-06-02 and was never updated. The OKR doc's own "Superseded (v2 → v3)" section retires it. Part B is answered against the live v3 set.

---

## A. The OKRs (v3, current cycle: Summer close-out through 2026-08-31)

**Vision:** "Be the best applied performance department in the country." **Structure:** 3 service pillars + 1 enabling objective. **Unit members:** Eric Rash, AJ (AP Specialist — Football), Noah (BB AP GA). Blake is **departed** (decision 0003) and co-owns nothing.

**Status for all 14 KRs is `⬜`** — no confidence values are recorded in any of these three docs (confidence lives in `okr-tracker/SCOREBOARD.md`, not read here).

**Objective 1 — Data Systems & Infrastructure**: "The data layer is standardized, governed, and survives staff transition; sport-facing delivery is bespoke on top of it and routinely drives coaching decisions."

| KR | Owner | Target / deadline |
|---|---|---|
| 1.1 Per-sport coach dashboards in routine weekly use — Football (through AJ) + Volleyball (direct), on shared data standards. "Used" = referenced in weekly planning meeting; core metrics fresh same-day | **AJ (FB), Eric (VB)** — split, not sole | ≥5 of 6 weeks, Jul 15 – Aug 31 |
| 1.2 Technology decision matrix revived and adopted as standard vendor intake — documented + Chris sign-off in writing | Eric | Adopted by Aug 31 |
| 1.3 HPI protocol v1 drafted — integration, flow, storage, dashboarding, interpretation; circulated to Chris + Kenny; walked through with Kenny | Eric | Circulated by Aug 31 |

**Objective 2 — Education**: "Applied Performance is a recognized source of education in the building — a launched, running engine, not an aspirational one." (Reset 2026-07-17, decision 0006: original 6-issue target was 0-for-3 at mid-July.)

| KR | Owner | Target |
|---|---|---|
| 2.1 Engine launched — 2 issues shipped (Issue #1 ~Aug 1 sleep module; #2 ~Aug 22 GLP-1 brief) | Eric | 2 issues by Aug 31 |
| 2.2 Both leadership-requested modules circulated for feedback | Eric | Circulated by Aug 31 |
| 2.3 Reach + demand baseline — distribution counts + inbound requests | Eric | Baseline recorded (targets set from evidence Aug 31) |

**Objective 3 — Research & Development**: "A real R&D engine — committee, repository, formalized partners — that produces publishable output and visibly feeds Baylor's R1 strategy."

| KR | Owner | Target |
|---|---|---|
| 3.1 BAIR Steering Committee organized — vetting process documented, first meeting scheduled w/ agenda | Eric | By Aug 31 |
| 3.2 Research repository MVP live | Eric | **By Jul 31** ("score honestly at review if late" — i.e. already past due) |
| 3.3 ≥1 academic partnership formalized — named project, written scope + timeline | Eric | By Aug 31 |
| 3.4 White paper drafted — Eric sole owner of critical path; **Blake credited as co-author, zero dependency on post-departure contributions** (decision 0005) | Eric | Drafted by Aug 31 |

**Objective 4 — Leadership & Visibility (enabling)**: "The director model demonstrably works: staff own their lanes, leadership is never surprised, and the department's work is visible without being asked for."

| KR | Owner | Target |
|---|---|---|
| 4.1 Friday report cadence live — biweekly email to Chris: Shipped / In Progress / Decisions Needed / Risks–No-Surprises / Next Two Weeks, <300 words | Eric | ≥3 sent by Aug 31 |
| 4.2 AJ full handoff through fall camp — AJ owns camp planning + plan-vs-actual review to football staff; Eric reviews artifacts pre-delivery, weekly 1:1 (decision 0004) | **AJ, Eric oversight** | 100% of camp practices on framework; review ≤1 wk post-camp |
| 4.3 Noah mentoring cadence — onboarding checklist, weekly 1:1, policies walkthrough | Eric | Checklist + cadence live **by Aug 15** |
| 4.4 Proactive supervisor meetings held — Kenny (HPI/research walkthrough) + H&W technology guidance, both Eric-initiated | Eric | Both held by Aug 31 |

**Eric's protected hands-on lanes** (never delegated): HPI protocol + its dashboarding; technology vetting; white-paper analysis; one-off report and dashboard creation for sports.

---

## B. Ladder check (14 job-lane projects vs. v3 KRs)

| Project | Ladders to |
|---|---|
| SPA_Presentation | **ORPHAN** — from the 2026-07-30 Chris Ruf meeting; not in OKR v3. (Distinct from the admin Briefing Asset in doc 3, which is itself not a KR.) |
| NCAA_BestPractices_Doc | **Weak / staged-only.** KR 1.1's Objective-1 "Staged to Fall" names "data-continuity plan per NCAA Best Practices document." Not a live summer KR → effectively ORPHAN this cycle. |
| Sport_Tech_Vetting | **KR 1.2.** ⚠ Contradiction: portfolio says `stage: shipped`, KR 1.2 says `⬜` not yet adopted / Chris sign-off outstanding. |
| OKRs_2026-27 | The OKR system itself — meta, not a KR. Governs 4.x. |
| Ask_The_Library | **ORPHAN** (Health & Performance Evidence Library). Adjacent to Objective 2/3, not named in any KR. |
| Coach_Report | **KR 1.1** (football post-session coach report, mirrors AJ's team report) — also sits in Eric's "one-off report/dashboard" protected lane. |
| Kinexon_Volleyball | **KR 1.1** (volleyball side, Eric direct). |
| Transformative_Athlete_Experience | **ORPHAN** — next action is Kenny Boyd sign-off; arguably feeds 4.4 (proactive Kenny meeting) but is not that KR. |
| ForcePlate_DecisionSystem | **KR 1.3** if the dashboard redesign is HPI dashboarding; otherwise ORPHAN. Not named in the doc → mark **uncertain**. |
| Risk_Stratification_Engine | **ORPHAN** — research prototype; no R&D KR covers it (3.1–3.4 are committee/repo/partnership/white-paper). |
| Travel_Map | **ORPHAN.** |
| SportScienceResearchRepo | **KR 3.2** (research repository MVP) — note this is the KR already past its Jul 31 date. |
| PlayerProfiles_FB | **ORPHAN** — falls in the one-off-report lane, not a KR. |
| SoftwareTech_Mgmt_Framework | **ORPHAN** — and the loudest one: active, Kenny Boyd whiteboard 2026-08-03, stakeholder presentation 2026-08-10 with John Allen and Micah, draft due 2026-08-07. Adjacent to KR 1.2 (vendor intake) but a separate, bigger, Kenny-facing artifact with no KR at all. |

**KRs with NO project attached:** 2.1, 2.2, 2.3 (the entire Education objective — newsletter engine, sleep + GLP-1 modules, reach baseline), 3.1 (BAIR committee), 3.3 (academic partnership), 3.4 (white paper), 4.1 (Friday report), 4.2 (AJ fall-camp handoff), 4.3 (Noah mentoring), 4.4 (supervisor meetings). That's **10 of 14 KRs with no portfolio project** — Objectives 2 and 4 are entirely invisible to the portfolio, while the portfolio's build-heavy work is largely invisible to the OKRs.

---

## C. Cadence doc (verbatim)

- **Meeting cadence:** "## The weekly check-in (Thursdays, ~20–30 min)" / "Standing meeting through the summer build; **dial to biweekly once in-season**." Agenda blocks: 0–2 open on SCOREBOARD; 2–20 KR round-robin by objective (≤2 min each: status color 🟢/🟡/🔴/✅, what moved, confidence now + why, blocker → who clears it, next action by next Thursday); 20–27 Eric decisions/cross-KR/rebalance; 27–30 update tracker (`okr.py check`) → `./backup.sh`.
- **The loop in one line:** "KR → a single next action → worked during the week → reviewed Thursday → confidence + next action updated in the tracker → repeats, laddering to the end-of-August score."
- **Monthly zoom-out:** "**Monthly (first check-in of the month):** a 5-minute zoom-out on each objective's **average confidence** — pour effort into the lagging pillar."
- **Escalation trigger:** "a KR red two weeks running, or confidence falling two weeks running → Eric reallocates time / clears the blocker, or the target gets renegotiated at the month boundary."
- **The gate:** "**Quarterly gate (end of August):** score each KR 0.0–1.0, mark met/partial/missed, then keep · retire · add, and author the Q2 set." Repeated at the end: "## At the gate (end of August) — Set each KR's `score` (0.0–1.0 attainment) in `okrs.yaml`, mark met / partial / missed, then keep · retire · add and author the Q2 set."
  - **What the gate is:** the end-of-August scoring event. What happens: numeric 0.0–1.0 score per KR in `okrs.yaml`, met/partial/missed label, then keep/retire/add, then author the next set. Confidence is defined throughout as "P(hit target by gate)."
  - ⚠ **Stale:** the cadence doc calls it a *quarterly* gate producing "the Q2 set." Decision 0007 (2026-07-17) retired quarterly cycles for semester cycles; the OKR doc's Aug 31 review now produces "the **Fall (Sep–Dec) set**" with a mid-semester checkpoint ~Oct 15. The date survives, the framing doesn't.
- **Reporting obligation to Kenny Boyd or Chris Ruf:** **No.** Grep confirms zero occurrences of "Chris," "Ruf," "Kenny," or "Boyd" in the cadence doc. It is an internal-unit operating doc only — notable, since the biweekly Friday report to Chris is a live KR (4.1) and the OKR doc calls it "the standing pulse between checkpoints."

---

## D. Roles

- **Chris Ruf — Eric's direct supervisor.** `JD-clarifying-questions.md` heading: "## For Chris (direct report — operational clarity)". Eric's memos are addressed "**To:** Chris Ruf · **Cc:** Kenny Boyd". Chris owns the sign-off on the technology decision matrix (KR 1.2), receives the biweekly report, and manages coaching staff transitions (equestrian, tennis). **Formal title: not stated** in any file found.
- **Kenny Boyd — secondary/dotted report, strategic and mandate authority.** Heading: "## For Kenny (secondary report — strategic and mandate clarity)". Vault evidence: Kenny was "elevated to direct report of Athletic Director [[Doug McLay]] for student-athlete care oversight"; "Direct oversight of student-athlete experience with elevated communication to Athletic Director." A weekly review records: "The decision-maker with authority to impose use + consequence is **Kenny Boyd**... Kenny Boyd sits upstream of two of next week's three priorities (HPI mandate + Databricks sponsorship)."
